data.name: apply-update-preflight-skeleton
data.description: apply/update now route through explicit preflight skeleton with ALLOWED_SYSTEMD_UNITS, secret redaction, path summaries, lock check, and non-executed command boundaries.
data.safety: No releases/<version> write, no current switch, no systemctl call, no PostgreSQL/Nginx/Docker/Admin/UOL/UI scope.

data.name: install-staged-release-boundary
data.description: Added resolveReleasePaths and installStagedRelease to copy verified shared/staging/<run-id>/stage bundles into releases/.installing-<run-id>, re-verify, then atomically rename to releases/<version> without switching current or calling systemctl.
data.safety: Rejects symlink or non-empty releases/<version>, current outside releases, staging escape, and unsafe run-id; failure cleanup is limited to releases/.installing-<run-id>.

data.name: candidate-migration-pre-switch
data.description: Added runCandidateMigration with injectable runner, cwd pinned to releases/<version>/migrator, redacted command output in updater log and shared/staging/<run-id>/apply.json, and runApply stops before current/systemd if migration fails.
data.safety: Does not switch current, does not restart gpt2image-web.service or gpt2image-chatgpt-web-proxy.service, and records db_migration_irreversible=true for post-migration rollback boundaries.

data.name: current-switch-and-whitelisted-restart
data.description: Added capturePreviousCurrent, switchCurrentSymlink, and restartWhitelistedServices; runApply now switches current after migration and restarts only gpt2image-web.service and gpt2image-chatgpt-web-proxy.service.
data.safety: Manifest units still pass assertAllowedSystemdUnits, systemctl runner is injectable, broad PostgreSQL/Nginx/Docker targets are rejected, and healthcheck rollback remains pending for TASK-005.

data.name: healthcheck-application-rollback-journal
data.description: Added writeApplyJournal, runHealthchecks, and rollbackApplicationLayer; apply now healthchecks after switch/restart and restores previous_current plus restarts whitelisted services if probes fail.
data.safety: Rollback only changes current and gpt2image-web.service/gpt2image-chatgpt-web-proxy.service; db_migration_irreversible remains true and database rollback is not automatic.

data.scope: scripts/local-updater.mjs apply/update migration switch restart healthcheck rollback self-test
data.result: passed; covers migration failure, healthcheck rollback, service whitelist, symlink escape, secret redaction, and stale lock without real systemctl/database/production URL

data.name: M1-P4 docs package gates
data.description: Documented mutating apply/update runbook, rollback boundary, final gates and M1-P5 Admin/UOL/UI non-goals; package exposes only updater:self-test:apply.
data.evidence: node scripts/local-updater.mjs --self-test apply; pnpm verify:binary-contract; pnpm lint; pnpm test; pnpm typecheck
